_comment: GH-250 golden set for the reminder title contract. Each sample feeds the REAL selector (reminder-display-selection.js) with an analyzer candidate, the normalized original message, the routing decision, and optionally the full analyzed source. The test asserts the acceptance criteria on every sample (budget, no mid-word cut, no addressee/please, no bare pointer, grounded) plus the per-sample expectation. The first group reproduces the reminders quoted in the issue; the rest cover each contract rule.

samples.note: issue problem 1: raw wording with the @mention and 'please' left in (verbatim path, synthesis off)

candidate.reminder_message: Wrap up the LTVera website layout improvements
candidate.actionable_language: wrap up the LTVera website layout improvements

samples.source: <@U_MIKE> can we please wrap up the LTVera website layout improvements tonight, please?

expect.text: Wrap up the LTVera website layout improvements tonight
